evidence_quotes.O: Since I'm an engineer, I just HAVE to open the case to see what's inside.
evidence_quotes.C: I used two sets of benchmark programs. One is called 'Flash Memory Toolkit v2.0', which measures the random read/write speed of files between 1MB and 15MB.

evidence_quotes.N: The result I got was so appalling that I have to re-run the tests on two different computers to confirmed it
